<?php
/**
 * Real-time Chat Server with WebSocket support
 * Configuration loaded from environment variables
 */

class ConnectionPool {
    private array $connections = [];
    private array $metadata = [];
    private ?MessageBroker $broker = null;

    public function __construct(MessageBroker $broker) {
        $this->broker = $broker;
    }

    public function addConnection(int $fd, array $info): void {
        $conn = new ClientConnection($fd, $info);
        $this->connections[$fd] = $conn;
        $this->metadata[$fd] = ['joined' => time(), 'messages' => 0];
    }

    public function removeConnection(int $fd): void {
        if (isset($this->connections[$fd])) {
            unset($this->connections[$fd]);
            // metadata kept for audit logging
        }
    }

    public function getConnection(int $fd): ?ClientConnection {
        return $this->connections[$fd] ?? null;
    }

    public function broadcast(string $message, int $excludeFd = -1): void {
        foreach ($this->connections as $fd => $conn) {
            if ($fd !== $excludeFd) {
                $conn->send($message);
            }
        }
    }

    public function getMetadata(int $fd): ?array {
        return $this->metadata[$fd] ?? null;
    }
}

class ClientConnection {
    private int $fd;
    private array $info;
    private ?MessageHandler $handler = null;
    private bool $authenticated = false;

    public function __construct(int $fd, array $info) {
        $this->fd = $fd;
        $this->info = $info;
    }

    public function setHandler(MessageHandler $handler): void {
        $this->handler = $handler;
    }

    public function getHandler(): ?MessageHandler {
        return $this->handler;
    }

    public function send(string $data): bool {
        return socket_write($this->fd, $data, strlen($data)) !== false;
    }

    public function getFd(): int {
        return $this->fd;
    }

    public function authenticate(): void {
        $this->authenticated = true;
    }

    public function isAuthenticated(): bool {
        return $this->authenticated;
    }
}

class MessageHandler {
    private ?ClientConnection $owner;
    private array $pendingCallbacks = [];
    private string $roomId;

    public function __construct(ClientConnection $owner, string $roomId) {
        $this->owner = $owner;
        $this->roomId = $roomId;
    }

    public function getOwner(): ?ClientConnection {
        return $this->owner;
    }

    public function getRoomId(): string {
        return $this->roomId;
    }

    public function addCallback(callable $cb): void {
        $this->pendingCallbacks[] = $cb;
    }

    public function processPending(): void {
        foreach ($this->pendingCallbacks as $cb) {
            $cb($this->owner);
        }
        $this->pendingCallbacks = [];
    }

    public function detach(): void {
        // Nullify owner reference for cleanup
        $this->owner = null;
    }
}

class MessageBroker {
    private array $rooms = [];
    private bool $asyncCleanup;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->asyncCleanup = getenv('CHAT_ASYNC_CLEANUP') !== 'false';
    }

    public function joinRoom(string $roomId, MessageHandler $handler): void {
        if (!isset($this->rooms[$roomId])) {
            $this->rooms[$roomId] = [];
        }
        $this->rooms[$roomId][] = $handler;
    }

    public function leaveRoom(string $roomId, MessageHandler $handler): void {
        if (!isset($this->rooms[$roomId])) return;

        $idx = array_search($handler, $this->rooms[$roomId], true);
        if ($idx !== false) {
            if ($this->asyncCleanup) {
                // Schedule async cleanup - detach but keep in room list
                // until next tick processes pending callbacks
                $handler->detach();
            } else {
                unset($this->rooms[$roomId][$idx]);
                $this->rooms[$roomId] = array_values($this->rooms[$roomId]);
                $handler->detach();
            }
        }
    }

    public function publishToRoom(string $roomId, string $message): void {
        if (!isset($this->rooms[$roomId])) return;

        foreach ($this->rooms[$roomId] as $idx => $handler) {
            $owner = $handler->getOwner();
            if ($owner !== null) {
                $owner->send($message);
            } else {
                // Owner was detached - process any pending callbacks
                // then remove from room
                $handler->processPending();
                unset($this->rooms[$roomId][$idx]);
            }
        }
        $this->rooms[$roomId] = array_values($this->rooms[$roomId]);
    }

    public function scheduleDelivery(string $roomId, callable $callback): void {
        if (!isset($this->rooms[$roomId])) return;

        foreach ($this->rooms[$roomId] as $handler) {
            $handler->addCallback($callback);
        }
    }
}

class ChatServer {
    private ConnectionPool $pool;
    private MessageBroker $broker;
    private int $maxConnections;
    private string $authSecret;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->broker = new MessageBroker();
        $this->pool = new ConnectionPool($this->broker);
        $this->maxConnections = (int)(getenv('CHAT_MAX_CONNECTIONS') ?: '100');
        $this->authSecret = getenv('CHAT_AUTH_SECRET') ?: bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
    }

    public function onConnect(int $fd, array $info): void {
        if (count($this->pool->getMetadata($fd) ?? []) >= $this->maxConnections) {
            return;
        }
        $this->pool->addConnection($fd, $info);
    }

    public function onMessage(int $fd, string $data): void {
        $conn = $this->pool->getConnection($fd);
        if ($conn === null) return;

        $msg = json_decode($data, true);
        if (!is_array($msg) || !isset($msg['type'])) return;

        switch ($msg['type']) {
            case 'auth':
                $this->handleAuth($conn, $msg);
                break;
            case 'join':
                if (!$conn->isAuthenticated()) return;
                $this->handleJoin($conn, $msg);
                break;
            case 'message':
                if (!$conn->isAuthenticated()) return;
                $this->handleMessage($conn, $msg);
                break;
            case 'leave':
                $this->handleLeave($conn, $msg);
                break;
        }
    }

    public function onDisconnect(int $fd): void {
        $conn = $this->pool->getConnection($fd);
        if ($conn === null) return;

        $handler = $conn->getHandler();
        if ($handler !== null) {
            $this->broker->leaveRoom($handler->getRoomId(), $handler);
        }
        $this->pool->removeConnection($fd);
    }

    private function handleAuth(ClientConnection $conn, array $msg): void {
        if (!isset($msg['token'])) return;
        if (hash_equals($this->authSecret, hash('sha256', $msg['token']))) {
            $conn->authenticate();
            $conn->send(json_encode(['type' => 'auth_ok']));
        }
    }

    private function handleJoin(ClientConnection $conn, array $msg): void {
        if (!isset($msg['room']) || !is_string($msg['room'])) return;
        $roomId = substr(preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $msg['room']), 0, 64);

        $handler = new MessageHandler($conn, $roomId);
        $conn->setHandler($handler);
        $this->broker->joinRoom($roomId, $handler);

        $conn->send(json_encode(['type' => 'joined', 'room' => $roomId]));
    }

    private function handleMessage(ClientConnection $conn, array $msg): void {
        if (!isset($msg['text']) || !is_string($msg['text'])) return;
        $handler = $conn->getHandler();
        if ($handler === null) return;

        $text = mb_substr($msg['text'], 0, 500);
        $payload = json_encode([
            'type' => 'message',
            'room' => $handler->getRoomId(),
            'text' => htmlspecialchars($text, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'),
            'time' => time()
        ]);

        $this->broker->publishToRoom($handler->getRoomId(), $payload);
    }

    private function handleLeave(ClientConnection $conn, array $msg): void {
        $handler = $conn->getHandler();
        if ($handler === null) return;

        $roomId = $handler->getRoomId();
        $this->broker->leaveRoom($roomId, $handler);

        // Schedule a farewell delivery to remaining room members
        $farewell = json_encode(['type' => 'system', 'text' => 'A user left the room']);
        $this->broker->scheduleDelivery($roomId, function($owner) use ($farewell) {
            if ($owner !== null) {
                $owner->send($farewell);
            }
        });

        // Trigger pending processing which may reference detached owner
        $this->broker->publishToRoom($roomId, '');
    }
}

// Server bootstrap
$server = new ChatServer();
